purpose: Reconcile DPR design station keys to the currently listed operational CTM stations using operator station sequences, DPR station chainages, corridor position, and official GIS locations. This records physical station correspondence, not a claim that every old DPR name was an authority-published alias.
policy: VERIFIED_ALIAS is reserved for exact or authority-confirmed aliases. VERIFIED_SPATIAL_CROSSWALK means the DPR design station and current operational stop are matched by corridor position/chainage and official GIS/operator station list. Sequence alone is insufficient. DPR-only proposals remain unbound.

corridors.crosswalkBasis: The operational corridor contains the current Line 7 stop sequence plus its shared Dahisar East terminal entity. The DPR has two additional design-only stations (Hub Mall and Vishveshwar Nagar) absent from the current MMRDA operational station list. The remaining 14 design rows are spatially reconciled using chainage, terminal orientation, current operator list, and official GIS points.

promotionBlockers: No authority source found that says whether the two Line 7 DPR-only proposals (Hub Mall and Vishveshwar Nagar) were formally deleted, consolidated, or relocated; they remain deliberately unbound.
Spatial crosswalks link design station evidence to operational entities but do not convert 2015 proposed levels, platform numbering, screen barriers, or facilities into verified as-built facts.

Platform-number-to-direction mapping and full transfer walking distance/time require current station wayfinding/layout or measured passenger-path evidence; route planner outputs are secondary and some disagree.
